newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 14.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday:
* California has plunged into a wholesale review of its managed care system.
* Despite all the corporate assistance, and the jobs and education and housing programs, the city of Newark, N.J., remains clutched in poverty.

* Madeleine Albright visited Prague for the first time since becoming Secretary of State and the first time since a biographer showed her parents had been born Jewish and that at least two of her grandparents had died in concentration camps.
* President Clinton has given early support to Vice President Gore's presidential aspirations, including taking steps to make sure the staff and resources of the White House are at his disposal.
* The New York State budget in Albany is 104 days late - a new record - but the state government has not been plunged into crisis.
